forecast_scope: Measured shortest/longest baseline-pulse extrapolation. High dose, other widths, output compression and observed-transition refinements can change runtime/storage; these are estimates, not an upper bound. Root must account for full-stage large outputs in DATA_MANIFEST before handoff.
reference_scope: All saved branch tails/gates independently recomputed; separately integrated direct-reference final states independently compared and their recorded scalar/tail flags reconciled. Direct-reference full time histories were not archived and were not rerun by this reviewer.
limits: This qualifies native adapter/shared-prefix/restart fidelity at the ten pilot basals, not all proposed dose/width trajectories or all spatial resolutions. Full campaign requires its own immutable source/input/reuse preflight and terminal readout verification.
No tested success among the five coarse durations does not exclude an unobserved success island. Any refined brackets must retain all observed nonmonotone transitions.
Nominal deBelly actuator coordinates and instantaneous-physical Spring support remain distinct; no cross-model optical/time calibration is implied.
